title: dep-scan expectations result
description: The result of evaluating a decisions file against one scan directory, written as depscan.expectations.json into the scan directory and produced by the same evaluator for depscan report and the get_decisions tool. Every expect and require entry carries its status, the findings it matched and the files that back the result.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this document's shape.

evaluatedUtc.description: When the evaluation ran, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

source.description: What evaluated the gate: the scan that produced the directory, a depscan report re-evaluation, or the get_decisions tool.

file.description: The decisions file: relative to the scan directory with / separators when a relative path exists, otherwise absolute.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the decisions file.

selectedBy.description: What selected the file: default, option, environment, project-config or user-config.

file.description: The VEX document, recorded the way the decisions file is.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of that document.

vex.description: Each VEX document the evaluation applied.

failOn.description: Each --fail-on expression the evaluation applied, as given.

decisions.description: The decisions the evaluation applied: the decisions file, the VEX documents and the --fail-on expressions, or null when it had none of them and worked from a baseline only.

scan.description: The baseline reference as given, relative to the decisions file or as passed to --baseline.

digest.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the baseline findings file, when the decisions file named one.

findings.description: How many findings the baseline holds.

baseline.description: The baseline the evaluation compared with, or null when the run had none.

expect.description: How many expect entries were evaluated or carried from the command line.

require.description: How many require entries were evaluated.

fail.description: How many fail-action expectations matched findings.

warn.description: How many warn-action expectations matched findings.

notEvaluated.description: How many entries could not be evaluated, with the reason on the entry.

requireNotAssessed.description: How many require entries found the capability not assessed.

suppressed.description: How many findings a triage decision suppresses from the gate.

new.description: How many findings are new against the baseline; 0 without one.

existing.description: How many findings are existing against the baseline; 0 without one.

summary.description: The counts the one-line summary and the console block repeat.

kind.description: Which kind of decisions entry this result answers.

id.description: The entry's id; a require entry without one takes the derived default.

description.description: The entry's description, when it carried one.

action.description: The expect entry's action; absent for require entries.

status.description: pass evaluated and matched nothing, fail matched with action fail, warn matched with action warn, not_evaluated with the reason.

reason.description: Why the entry was not evaluated, or the summary of a require failure.

findings.description: The ids of the findings the entry matched.

projectType.description: The stage's project type, when it ran for one.

items.description: One manifest stage the require entry evaluated.

stages.description: The manifest stages a require entry evaluated, as its evidence.

evidence.description: The files inside the scan directory that back this result: depscan.findings.json for expectations, depscan.manifest.json for requirements.

results.description: One result per expect and require entry, in file order with the command-line entries last.

warnings.description: What the reader must know about how this result was reached: a decisions file the scan recorded that could not be found, so the gate result the scan saved was kept, or one whose digest changed since the scan, so the result reflects the file as it is now.

applied.description: How many live triage decisions won at least one finding.

suppressed.description: How many findings a decision suppresses from the gate. Findings are counted, so two findings that share a fingerprint count twice.

expired.description: The decisions past their expiry. They suppressed nothing, and each names the findings it would have matched.

stale.description: The decisions that matched no finding in the scan, with their selectors.

proposals.description: The proposals waiting for a person to approve them.

shadowed.description: The live decisions that matched findings another decision decides: a finding selector beats an advisory selector, then the first entry in file order wins. Each names the findings it lost.

triage.description: What the triage decisions did, including the entries that need attention. Each finding takes one winning decision.

index.description: The entry's 1-based position among the triage decisions.

handle.description: The entry's stable handle, which depscan triage review and remove take: tr- and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-256 of its canonical selector, with proposed_by for a proposal.

selector.description: The entry's selector as the file carries it: finding, or advisory with purl and version_range.

author.description: Who entered the decision, when named.

approver.description: Who approved the decision, when named.

proposedBy.description: Who or what proposed the decision, when named.

expires.description: When the decision expires, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

findings.description: The findings the entry matched or would have matched.

entryReport.description: One triage entry the reader should look at, with what it matched.
